turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Sat Sri Akal Harpreet ji. Sugar kaisi chal rahi hai?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Doctor sahab, 3 mahine se sugar control nahi ho rahi, goliyan time pe le raha hoon phir bhi.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Aaj khane ke baad wali sugar 312 aayi hai. Weight 88 kg aur BP 138 by 86. Aapki type 2 diabetes uncontrolled hai, ab insulin start karna padega.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Haan, din mein sirf ek baar, raat ko sone se pehle. Insulin Glargine 10 units, roz raat ko. Gliclazide ab band kar do, uski zaroorat nahi. Metformin 1000 mg subah-shaam chalu rakho.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Theek hai. Koi allergy wali baat nahi hai mujhe kisi dawai se.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Achha. Ghar pe glucometer se roz subah khali pet sugar check karke likhna.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Agar sugar 70 se neeche jaaye, ya pasina, kaanpna, ghabrahat ho, toh turant cheeni ya juice lo aur call karo. Aur agar seene mein dard ya bahut pasina aaye toh seedha emergency.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: 2 hafte baad sugar chart lekar aana, insulin ka dose adjust karenge.
